body.p: Very long ago there live a man and a woman. They had a child. They started to wander to tents [i.e. to a camp]. They didn't know that ogres were living there. The man and the woman brought their child to a woman, for that she has a look after it. They made their tent, [then] the woman went for her child. The ogre woman gave a cradle. Going out the woman saw hands of a child in the kettle. When the woman came home, she told her husband. The woman said: "When it becomes night, we'll wander off". Then woman went out, she heard speaking. The ogres say: "Let's kill them, when they lie down to sleep". At night the woman and the man stood up, they broke down half of the tent. The woman said to the man: "Bring the things(?) to the boat. I'll come in a minute". They drove off on the river. In the morning they saw the ogres chasing [them]. The man stayed on a mountain, taking bow and arrow. The woman ran further. Her husband said: "Don't wait for me. I won't come. Go to good people". The woman reached some tents, [the ogres] killed the man.
